newsitem.title: USA: Federal Screw Works sets extra payout.
newsitem.headline: Federal Screw Works sets extra payout.

text.p: Federal Screw Works on Friday said its board of directors declared an extra cash dividend of $1.60 a share, in addition to an unchanged regular quarterly dividend of $0.10 a share.
The manufacturer of fasteners and other products for the automotive industry said both dividends are payable October 1 to shareholders of record on September 5.
Federal Screw Works said earnings for its fourth quarter ended June 30 rose to $3.35 million, or $3.08 a share, from year-earlier earnings of $1.9 million, or $1.77 a share.
For the full fiscal year, the company earned $7.2 million, or $6.60 a share, versus $4.4 million, or $4.04 a share, a year earlier.
